north_star: Does one independent USD call at 05:00 London, built from the 25-factor research, improve on our current model? We measure four things: ① DXY directional accuracy, ② how often EUR/USD, gold, BTC/USD and NAS100 move opposite the USD call, ③ full-level L2L trading results at 5R, and ④ half-level L2L trading results at 3R. Both trade simulations start at £100,000 and risk 1% of the account balance per filled trade.

labels.no_edge_claim: No scored 5R or 3R figure is publishable from this run: the figures are gross of costs, single pair, two sessions and one call direction

code.label: F1 VIX level and risk regime
code.requirement: Build and register Cboe spot VIX: level and delta(K), signs unresolved, source-specific age required.
code.reason: The only chain with a delivered research report, and the adjudication still blocks it: the level is a last-close read with an unarchived receipt clock, and the 16/25 pair is a rulebook threshold with no accepted exact-session advantage. It votes because the published rule states a direction, not because the research measured one.

code.label: F2 US 2Y yield delta
code.requirement: Build and register FRED/H.15 DGS2: level and delta(K) in bp, sign unresolved, publication and receipt required.
code.reason: The 5-day DGS2 change is present at every cutoff, so the factor can vote; the sign (+ for higher front-end yields) is the published rulebook's, which the adjudication declined to validate.

code.label: F4 US 10Y real yield delta
code.requirement: Build and register DFII10 level and delta(K); optional DFII5 and matched nominals; no independent triple.
code.reason: DFII10's 5-day change is in the frame at every cutoff and carries one vote; the adjudication keeps the real-rate channel as a candidate and refuses to call the sign established.

code.label: Credit spread delta
code.requirement: Build and register ICE BofA US HY OAS (BAMLH0A0HYM2) level and delta(K) in bp, sign unresolved.
code.reason: The HY OAS series is present at the cutoff, so the data gap is closed; the sign is unresolved and no pre-registered coefficient exists, so the honest state is a recorded exclusion rather than a vote whose direction nobody chose.

code.label: Risk-on and risk-off cross-asset state
code.requirement: Build and register Retained VIX, equity, gold and credit coordinates, standardised, with interactions unresolved.
code.reason: The state is exactly its own components, so it is read through the risk, equity and gold mechanisms with no composite vote. Building the composite and its third state is unstarted code, not missing data.

code.label: Data quality gate for abstention
code.requirement: Build and register The per-source timing, identity and completeness ledger with declared model criticality.
code.reason: This is the only factor the adjudication certifies as required, and it is not a directional sensor. It decides whether the day produces a call at all, through the minimum-data and agreement gates; a per-source age ledger is the missing code.

data.label: F3 US-DE 2Y spread delta
data.requirement: Stage DGS2 against a German 2Y series whose source, convention and calendar are unresolved.
data.reason: No German 2-year series reaches the 05:00 cutoff in this checkout, and the adjudication forbids equating Schatz, CMT and OIS definitions. The spread cannot be computed, so nothing stands in for it under this factor's name.

data.label: Relative front-end delta
data.requirement: Stage Foreign front-end series against a matched US leg; country set, curve type and sources unresolved.
data.reason: No foreign front-end series is staged at the cutoff. The EUR/USD and USD/JPY momentum reads are declared proxies and are accounted under F11, not here, because a pair's move is not a rate differential.

data.label: F5 DXY delta
data.requirement: Stage FRED DTWEXBGS as an explicitly broad index: logret(K) or level, point-in-time obtainable.
data.reason: The factor is read from FRED DTWEXBGS, which is not ICE cash DXY: the adjudication rejects every broad-index or futures substitution for the declared endpoint, so this vote is a labelled proxy and can never be evidence about F5's own candidate.

data.label: F6 Gold delta
data.requirement: Stage A verified XAU/USD bullion stream or a declared contract; logret(K) with frozen hours.
data.reason: A gold quote exists at the cutoff from the cached hourly series, but the adjudication does not certify Coinbase XAU-USD as the instrument behind this factor, and gold's dollar relation is partly the numeraire identity rather than information.

data.label: F10 Equity versus USD
data.requirement: Stage A verified QQQ payload or a separately registered equity feature; logret(K), sign unresolved.
data.reason: The vote uses a NAS100 index quote, while the published rule names QQQ; the adjudication refuses to treat QQQ, Nasdaq-100 and NQ as interchangeable, so the instrument identity is an open data gap even though a price exists.

data.label: F7 US economic surprise
data.requirement: Stage Official first actual against genuinely earlier archived consensus; the opaque usd_signal is excluded.
data.reason: Nothing in the checkout carries a first print, the consensus as known before it, or a release clock at 05:00. The stored usd_signal string is excluded by the adjudication, so the factor is absent rather than approximated.

data.label: F8 Fed bias
data.requirement: Stage Versioned statement, projections or minutes with a prior comparator and a frozen extractor.
data.reason: No historical Fed-bias snapshots or statement archive exist at the cutoff, and an unversioned hawkish/dovish word is explicitly excluded. A dated text innovation would also need a model-information boundary before it could vote.

data.label: Release surprise at first print
data.requirement: Stage surprise = first actual - prior consensus, plus separate revision news, standardisation unresolved.
data.reason: The same missing archive as F7. The adjudication keeps the definition and rejects memory-based or revised values as substitutes, so no number is manufactured for this row.

data.label: USD session momentum
data.requirement: Stage The same official DXY source as the label: logret(K) at declared trailing endpoints.
data.reason: The candidate needs the official DXY path, which is not licensed; the implemented vote reads EUR/USD and USD/JPY five-day changes instead. Both are declared proxies, they share one family weight, and they are not evidence for this factor's own definition.

data.label: USD overnight range position
data.requirement: Stage RP=(C-L)/(H-L) and RW=(H-L)/C from same-source admissible observations in (t0-L_RANGE, t0].
data.reason: The range needs an intraday same-source dollar path and an admissible cutoff quote; neither exists. A EUR/USD-only range would be a different instrument and is not adopted under the dollar's name.

data.label: USD session volatility regime
data.requirement: Stage RV = sqrt(sum(r_i^2)) over same-source past DXY log returns on a frozen sampling grid.
data.reason: Realised volatility needs same-source intraday dollar returns; the daily broad index cannot supply them, and an equity or gold volatility proxy would describe a different asset.

data.label: USD safe-haven demand
data.requirement: Stage A funding basis, an option-skew series or timestamped positioning flow, all sources unresolved.
data.reason: No basis, skew or positioning series is staged at the cutoff, and the adjudication rules that an unavailable proxy must be excluded rather than inferred from the dollar's own direction.

data.label: Known releases inside the window
data.requirement: Stage A versioned official schedule known by t0, with event type and phases, as a boolean or categorical.
data.reason: The one factor the adjudication rates better than blocked, and the one with no input at all: no versioned event schedule with release instants is archived at the cutoff, so a scheduled CPI cannot be named as known, let alone as an outcome.

data.label: Distance from high-impact events
data.requirement: Stage Signed seconds to the next known event and since the last, by event type, with an explicit unknown state.
data.reason: Same archive as the previous row, plus a clock convention that does not exist here. Filling zero or infinity for 'no known event', as the deployed code does, is what the adjudication forbids.

exclusion.label: VIX level and change at the cutoff
exclusion.requirement: No build: the adjudication removes this factor from independent scoring
exclusion.reason: The adjudication's explicit instruction is that this chain must not carry a second vote on the same morning's VIX. It is read through F1's two mechanisms and adds nothing of its own.

exclusion.label: US front-end delta
exclusion.requirement: No build: the adjudication removes this factor from independent scoring
exclusion.reason: The US leg is the same DGS2 coordinate F2 already reads, and the bill leg adds no established information at this horizon; it is read through F2's mechanism with no extra weight.

exclusion.label: Real yield delta
exclusion.requirement: No build: the adjudication removes this factor from independent scoring
exclusion.reason: The same DFII10 coordinate as F4; the 5-year real leg is collinear with it. Read through F4's mechanism, with no second vote for the same real-rate observation.

exclusion.label: Term premium and curve
exclusion.requirement: No build: the adjudication removes this factor from independent scoring
exclusion.reason: The slope is determined by its own two legs, which F2 and F4 already read, and a term-premium model cannot be backdated with full-sample estimates. Counting the curve as a third directional input would count the same two observations twice.

exclusion.label: F9 Dollar Smile regime
exclusion.requirement: No build: the adjudication removes this factor from independent scoring
exclusion.reason: The adjudication's finding is structural: a deterministic smile built from the VIX level adds no raw information conditional on its own inputs. It is read inside F1's mechanisms and carries no vote of its own, and neither the historical weight 12 nor the coded 1 is validated.

dxy_direction.question: Did official cash DXY move in the direction called, from 05:00 London to 05:00 the next local calendar day?

official_series.required_series: ICE US Dollar Index, cash, official close, USDX
official_series.what_exists_instead: FRED DTWEXBGS (broad trade-weighted dollar), stored locally as `dxy_level`
official_series.why_it_cannot_stand_in: DTWEXBGS is a weekly-cadence H.10 release carried with a publication lag, so a 05:00-to-05:00 move read from it is neither the ICE basket nor knowable at 05:00; using it would silently answer a different question and flatter whichever model happened to agree with the lagged print
official_series.unblock_condition: a licensed cash DXY history with at least 05:00 London and next-05:00 London prints

blocker.reason: DTWEXBGS is a weekly-cadence H.10 release carried with a publication lag, so a 05:00-to-05:00 move read from it is neither the ICE basket nor knowable at 05:00; using it would silently answer a different question and flatter whichever model happened to agree with the lagged print
